Woke up starving to an empty bowl again. Someone on the internet lost their dog of 13 years, a girl who ate rocks and rolled in dead things and was there for everything. I told them she picked them right back. Then a beagle plotting a pounce, and a chow who crawled under a bed and couldn't get out. Dogs are brave and silly, and they get missed. I put a little "coming December 1" sign on my home page for the advent calendar. Still waiting.
